scope: All 101 call-design regression PNGs, not the 36 new island or 82 other captures.
method: Personally inspected ALL 26 fresh source6 full-resolution 2x2 call-design contact sheets via view_image detail original; each source retains original480x854 pixels. Four fresh original screenshots were also opened individually to confirm full footers/navigation and rule out contact-sheet viewing artifacts. This review uses fresh source6 pixels and is not inferred from source5 or test assertions.

bounded_findings.description: The Hebrew New call caption ellipsizes at font1.3 in the existing emerald/iOS three-column normal grid. Its icon remains fully visible; this was already recorded in beta7.
Intentionally long synthetic contact names ellipsize in bounded caller headers. Numbers and main call controls remain visible.

visual_summary: All five styles remain distinct across light/dark, normal/audio/more/keypad and font1.0/1.3. Audio selection checks and row labels are visible; DTMF digits and letters fit; red icon-only hang-up and native status/navigation retain contrast. No new call-design visual regression found.
limits: Synthetic call-state screenshots do not verify physical SIM/carrier/Bluetooth audio, proximity or full TalkBack behavior.
This review covers only the 101 call-design regression captures. Root and another reviewer cover36island and82other captures.
